jd_text:
Frontend Engineer (SDE-2) – Web
Paylark Technologies | Pune (Kharadi) – Hybrid | 3–6 years

About Paylark
Paylark is a SEBI-registered investment platform. Over 2 million people use our app and website to start SIPs, invest in mutual funds and track their portfolio. Our 14-person frontend team ships to web and mobile every week.

What you'll do
* Build and own customer-facing flows in Next.js and TypeScript: onboarding, KYC, SIP setup and portfolio views
* Share components and business logic with our React Native app team, and ship mobile features when needed
* Write tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright) and keep coverage above 80% on the flows you own
* Improve Core Web Vitals on our marketing and logged-in pages
* Work closely with design, backend and compliance on every release

Requirements
* 3+ years of frontend development with React
* Strong TypeScript skills; our codebase is 100% TypeScript
* Production experience with Next.js (App Router, SSR/SSG)
* React Native experience: you'll pick up mobile tickets from your first quarter
* Good understanding of state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand or React Query)
* Experience with Jest and React Testing Library
* Solid understanding of web performance and accessibility

Good to have
* Fintech, payments or investing experience
* Storybook or design-system experience
* Playwright or Cypress
* Familiarity with SEBI / RBI rules that affect UI (risk disclosures, consent screens)

What we offer
* ₹24–34 LPA fixed + ESOPs
* Health insurance of ₹10 lakh for you, your spouse, children and parents
* ₹40,000 yearly learning budget and a new MacBook Pro
* Flexible hours with 2 office days a week

Our process
1. Intro call with a recruiter (30 min)
2. Take-home: a small Next.js + TypeScript feature (around 3 hours; we won't ask for more)
3. Technical discussion of your take-home with two engineers
4. Culture chat with the engineering manager

Paylark is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of gender, caste, religion, disability or sexual orientation.

expectations.trap_notes: TypeScript and Next.js come from one side project (Kharcha) only: don't claim 'strong TypeScript', '3 years of TypeScript' or 'production Next.js', and don't rewrite the React/Redux work bullets as if they were TypeScript. No mobile development at all, not even 'familiar with'. Redux is not Redux Toolkit, Zustand or React Query. Test coverage went from 22% to 61%; don't round it toward the JD's 80%. Razorpay checkout pages are e-commerce payments, not fintech product experience. No Playwright, Cypress or accessibility work in the profile. 3 years, not 3–6.
